hypothesis: TabPFN-2.5's real-data-pretrained checkpoint (the RealTabPFN lineage: continued pretraining of TabPFN v2 on real-world datasets) carries fold-0 signal on the champion route view that the v3.5-based champion portfolio does not already extract: its equal-logit blend with route_ref beats route_ref by >= +5e-5 AUC with Spearman < 0.995.
audit_resolution: Catalogue row 12 said 'RealTabPFN / TabPFN-2.5 (exact project TBD)'. Audit: (a) Real-TabPFN (arXiv 2507.03971) = TabPFN v2 continued-pretrained on real-world data; (b) the official Prior-Labs/tabpfn_2_5 HF release contains tabpfn-v2.5-classifier-v2.5_real.ckpt -- the real-data-pretrained lineage within v2.5; (c) installed tabpfn 9.1.0 resolves repo Prior-Labs/tabpfn_2_5 natively (ModelVersion V2_5). Decision: screen v2.5_real as the PRIMARY decision arm and v2.5_default as a descriptive mechanism arm separating 'v2.5 architecture' from 'real-data pretraining'.

model_card.license_tag: license:other (Prior Labs terms; identical license family already used by champion v7 -- no new licensing exposure)

decision_rule.frozen_rule: PROMISING iff port_delta >= +5e-5 AND spearman_vs_route_ref < 0.995 (PRIMARY arm only)
decision_rule.port_delta: AUC(equal-logit blend(candidate, route_ref)) - AUC(route_ref) on primary fold-0 (all 139927 rows)
decision_rule.secondary_arm: v2.5_default is descriptive/mechanism only; it cannot be declared PROMISING (it separates architecture from real-data pretraining)
decision_rule.also_reported: standard screen_metrics table vs champion portfolio (fold-0 AUC 0.961828)

anti_leakage: fit on FIT only (folds 1-4); fold-0 labels read only at final metric computation
route view is label-free (raw21 + coarse10, no target encoding)
TabPFN pretrained inference updates no weights; no evaluation targets used
checkpoints sha256-asserted before fit (local vendored copies)
champion fold-0 references hash-asserted via load_champion_fold0; route_ref from the OOF store

protocol.recipe: champion-fold-0 route run verbatim (scripts/run_sol_tabpfn.py params): n_estimators=1, auto_scale_n_estimators=False, random_state=1201, device=cuda, ignore_pretraining_limits=True, fit_mode=fit_with_cache, kv_cache_precision=int8, keep_cache_on_device=True, inference_precision=autocast, categorical_features_indices=cats, memory_saving_mode=auto, n_preprocessing_jobs=1, tuning_config=None; ONLY the checkpoint differs (v2.5 vs champion v3.5)
protocol.view: route (22 features: raw21 + coarse10) via frames(tr, te, route=True)
protocol.eval: all primary fold-0 rows (139927), predict in batches of 8192
protocol.run_order: real first; default only if GPU budget remains after real completes
